label: scope4-novel-hardening-accumulates
description: Authored Scope 4 arrival-conversion case: post-threshold novel verification-hardening findings accumulate as plan-review debt WITHOUT extending the round count. Rounds 1-2 fix plan-correctness findings to reach the default threshold (3). Rounds 3-4 each co-emit a first-occurrence hardening finding (C3, C5) that banks as deferred debt on arrival AND a plan-correctness finding (C4, C6) that forces the round. Round 5 emits only a first-occurrence hardening finding (C7), which banks and lands the review accepted-with-debt. Across rounds 3-5 three hardening asks convert to debt while every revision round was driven by a plan_correctness finding, never by a hardening ask.
